speaker: Dean Radin
abstract: The original research proposal specified a recruitment target of N = 30 participants. Participants were recruited from … Because this was a pilot study and we were able to collect additional data, the analyses reported here were conducted on a final cohort of N = 50 participants, partitioned into a 10-participant validation set (used for model calibration) and a 40-participant held-out test set (used exclusively for confirmatory out-of-sample analysis). All primary confirmatory results are reported for the strict test set (N = 40); the full cohort (N = 50) is reported as a secondary check. The departure from the originally proposed sample size is noted for transparency.
